name: Phillips Curve
original_paper: Phillips AW (1958) Economica 25:283-299
data_source: World Bank WDI: SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS, FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG

name: Laffer Curve
original_paper: Laffer A (1974) unpublished (napkin sketch)
data_source: OECD Tax Database Table I.7 (top personal income tax rate, PERS_ITAX) + OECD Global Revenue Statistics (total tax as % of GDP)
x_variable: Top marginal personal income tax rate (%)

name: Kuznets Curve
original_paper: Kuznets S (1955) Am Econ Rev 45:1-28
data_source: World Bank WDI: NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, SI.POV.GINI

name: Environmental Kuznets Curve (CO2)
original_paper: Grossman GM, Krueger AB (1991) NBER WP 3914
data_source: World Bank WDI: NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, EN.ATM.CO2E.PC

name: Beveridge Curve
original_paper: Beveridge W (1944) Full Employment in a Free Society
data_source: US BLS API: CPS unemployment (LNS14000000) + JOLTS job openings rate (JTS...JOR), annual means

name: Okun's Law
original_paper: Okun AM (1962) Proceedings of the Business and Economic Statistics Section, ASA
data_source: World Bank WDI: NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS

name: Engel Curve
original_paper: Engel E (1857) Die Produktions- und Consumtionsverhältnisse des Königreichs Sachsen
data_source: OWID food expenditure share (USDA ERS) + World Bank WDI GDP per capita PPP, matched by ISO3
current_period: most recent common year per country (2010-2023)

name: J-Curve (Trade)
original_paper: Magee SP (1973) The Balance of Payments. Brookings Papers
data_source: World Bank WDI: PX.REX.REER (US real effective exchange rate) + NE.RSB.GNFS.ZS (US external balance %GDP), years since the 1985 REER peak; RECONSTRUCTION of the post-Plaza-Accord depreciation episode (peak year chosen from the data, not hard-coded; annual, not the textbook stylized quarterly episode)

name: Rahn Curve
original_paper: Rahn RW (1996) Institute for Policy Innovation
data_source: OWID historical government expenditure (IMF general govt) + World Bank WDI real GDP growth, 2010-2019 means

name: Gravity Model of Trade
original_paper: Tinbergen J (1962) Shaping the World Economy
data_source: CEPII Gravity database V202211 (GDP_o, GDP_d, dist, BACI bilateral trade), ordered country pairs 2019

name: Great Gatsby Curve
original_paper: Corak M (2013) J Econ Perspect 27(3):79-102
data_source: Reconstruction: World Bank GDIM income mobility IGE (Munoz & van der Weide 2025, WP 11166) + OWID/World Bank Gini index (PIP). Not the original Corak figure.

name: Balassa-Samuelson Effect
original_paper: Balassa B (1964) J Political Economy 72:584-596
data_source: Penn World Table 10.01: productivity (rgdpo/emp) and price level (pl_gdpo)

name: Preston Curve
original_paper: Preston SH (1975) Popul Stud 29:231-248
data_source: World Bank WDI: NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, SP.DYN.LE00.IN

name: Easterlin Paradox
original_paper: Easterlin RA (1974) in Nations and Households in Economic Growth
data_source: OWID Cantril ladder (World Happiness Report / Gallup) + World Bank WDI GDP per capita PPP, matched by ISO3
current_period: most recent common year per country (2010-2023)

name: McKeown Thesis (TB Mortality)
original_paper: McKeown T (1976) The Modern Rise of Population. Edward Arnold
data_source: McKeown, Record & Turner (1975) Population Studies 29(3):391-422, Table 4: respiratory tuberculosis standardized death rate per million (England & Wales, age/sex-standardized to 1901), decades 1901-1971; transcribed (see data/digitized_sources.md)
y_variable: Respiratory TB deaths per million (std. to 1901)

name: Linear No-Threshold (LNT)
original_paper: ICRP (1958) Publication 1; Ozasa et al. (2012) Radiat Res 177:229-243
data_source: Ozasa et al. (2012) Radiat Res 177:229-243, Fig. 4 (erratum-corrected low-dose point), ERR vs weighted colon dose; digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Fries Compression of Morbidity
original_paper: Fries JF (1980) N Engl J Med 303:130-135
data_source: Fries JF (1980) NEJM 303:130-135, Fig. 2 (idealized US 1980 survival curve, % surviving vs age); digitized. NOTE: variable definition changed from the previous 'year vs morbidity duration', which matched no figure/table in Fries 1980 (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Barker Hypothesis (U-shape)
original_paper: Barker DJP (1990) BMJ 301:1111
data_source: Osmond, Barker, Winter, Fall & Simmonds (1993) BMJ 307:1519-1524, Tables I-II (SMR all cardiovascular disease by birth weight, women+men); transcribed (see data/digitized_sources.md)
claimed_form: U-shaped (NOT supported: source is monotonically decreasing)

name: Omran Epidemiological Transition
original_paper: Omran AR (1971) Milbank Mem Fund Q 49:509-538
data_source: UNDP HDI (composite index) + World Bank WDI SH.DTH.NCOM.ZS (NCD mortality)

name: Wilkinson Curve
original_paper: Wilkinson RG (1996) Unhealthy Societies. Routledge
data_source: Wilkinson RG (1992) BMJ 304:165-168, Fig. 2 (life expectancy vs % income to least well-off 70%, 9 OECD countries); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: BMI-Mortality J-Curve
original_paper: Various; Global BMI Mortality Collaboration (2016) Lancet 388:776-786
data_source: Global BMI Mortality Collaboration (2016) Lancet 388:776-786, primary analysis HRs by 9 BMI groups (transcribed; see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Alcohol-Mortality J-Curve
original_paper: Di Castelnuovo A et al. (2006) Arch Intern Med 166:2437-2445
data_source: Di Castelnuovo et al. (2006) Arch Intern Med 166:2437-2445, pooled fixed-effects dose-response (RR all-cause mortality vs g/day); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Demographic Transition Model
original_paper: Notestein FW (1945) in Population: The Long View
data_source: World Bank WDI: SP.DYN.TFRT.IN; UNDP HDI

name: Bongaarts-Feeney Tempo Adjustment
original_paper: Bongaarts J, Feeney G (1998) Popul Dev Rev 24:271-291
data_source: Bongaarts & Feeney (1998) Popul Dev Rev 24:271-291, Fig. 3 (observed vs tempo-adjusted TFR, US 1950-90); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Lee-Carter Mortality Model
original_paper: Lee RD, Carter LR (1992) J Am Stat Assoc 87:659-671
data_source: HMD USA period death rates (Mx_1x1); kappa_t estimated by Lee-Carter SVD (raw HMD data not redistributed)
current_period: HMD USA years with full age coverage (1933-present)

name: Coale-Trussell Fertility Schedule
original_paper: Coale AJ, Trussell TJ (1974) Popul Index 40:185-258
data_source: Coale & Trussell (1974/1978) Population Index 40(2):185-258, standard natural-fertility schedule n(a); public-domain table transcription (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Replacement Migration Curve
original_paper: UN Population Division (2000) Replacement Migration
data_source: UN (2000) 'Replacement Migration' report, Table IV.1 (TFR 1995-2000) and Table IV.6 (Scenario IV migrants per million, constant working-age pop). MODEL OUTPUTS.
y_variable: Required net migration, Scenario IV (per million/yr)

name: Second Demographic Transition
original_paper: Van de Kaa DJ (1987) Popul Bull 42(1):1-57
data_source: World Bank WDI: SP.DYN.TFRT.IN; UNDP HDI

name: Species-Area Curve
original_paper: Arrhenius O (1921) J Ecol 9:95-99
data_source: Johnson & Raven (1973) Science 179:893-895, Galapagos archipelago plant species vs island area (faraway 'gala' dataset; see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Hubbert Peak Oil
original_paper: Hubbert MK (1956) Nuclear Energy and the Fossil Fuels. API
data_source: US EIA Total Energy: crude oil production (MSN=PAPRPUS)

name: Keeling Curve (CO2)
original_paper: Keeling CD (1960) Tellus 12:200-203
data_source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory: Mauna Loa CO2 annual means

name: HANPP
original_paper: Vitousek PM et al. (1986) BioScience 36:368-373
data_source: Haberl et al. (2007) PNAS gridded HANPP/NPP0 (year 2000), aggregated to countries by zonal statistics (Natural Earth admin-0) + OWID/World Bank GDP per capita PPP (2000)

name: Jevons Paradox (Energy)
original_paper: Jevons WS (1865) The Coal Question. Macmillan
data_source: US EIA Total Energy (MSN=TETCBUS) + World Bank WDI US real GDP (intensity)

name: Forest Transition Curve
original_paper: Mather AS (1992) Area 24:367-379
data_source: World Bank WDI: NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, AG.LND.FRST.ZS

name: Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve
original_paper: Ebbinghaus H (1885) Über das Gedächtnis
data_source: Ebbinghaus (1885) Memory, Ch.VII Section 28-29 original savings table (7 relearning intervals; public domain; see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Dunning-Kruger Effect
original_paper: Kruger J, Dunning D (1999) J Pers Soc Psychol 77:1121-1134
data_source: Kruger & Dunning (1999) JPSP 77:1121-1134, Figs. 1-4 (perceived ability vs actual percentile, Studies 1-4); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Happiness U-Curve (Age)
original_paper: Stone, Schwartz, Broderick & Deaton (2010) PNAS 107(22):9985-9990
data_source: Stone et al. (2010) PNAS 107:9985-9990, Fig. 1 (Global WB Cantril ladder by 4-yr age group, unadjusted 'Age alone'); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Hubble's Law
original_paper: Hubble E (1929) Proc Natl Acad Sci 15:168-173
data_source: Hubble E (1929) PNAS 15:168-173, Table 1 (24 nebulae, public domain); distance vs recession velocity
claimed_form: Linear (v = H₀d); nonlinear acceleration at high z

name: Kleiber's Law
original_paper: Kleiber M (1932) Hilgardia 6:315-353
data_source: AnAge database (Human Ageing Genomic Resources; Tacutu et al. 2018 Nucleic Acids Res): metabolic rate (W) and body mass for 422 mammal species (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Gutenberg-Richter Law
original_paper: Gutenberg B, Richter CF (1944) Bull Seismol Soc Am 34:185-188
data_source: USGS Earthquake Catalog (ComCat); ISC-GEM Global Instrumental Catalogue

name: Moore's Law
original_paper: Moore GE (1965) Electronics 38:114-117
data_source: Karl Rupp semiconductor database; Wikipedia transistor count list (verified against datasheets)

name: Lipset Hypothesis
original_paper: Lipset SM (1959) Am Polit Sci Rev 53:69-105
data_source: World Bank WDI GDP per capita PPP + Freedom House FIW aggregate score
current_period: latest WDI GDP + Freedom House edition

name: Duverger's Law
original_paper: Duverger M (1954) Political Parties. Wiley
data_source: Bormann & Golder, Democratic Electoral Systems (DES) 5.0 (Electoral Studies 2022): tier-1 average district magnitude vs effective number of electoral parties, legislative elections (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Zipf's Law (US Cities)
original_paper: Zipf GK (1949) Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort
data_source: US Census Bureau 2020 Decennial (dec/pl) place populations (P1_001N), API

name: Crime-Temperature Curve
original_paper: Anderson CA (1987) J Pers Soc Psychol 52:1161-1173
data_source: FBI UCR data; NOAA climate normals; Ranson (2014) J Environ Econ Manage

name: Putnam Social Capital
original_paper: Putnam RD (2000) Bowling Alone. Simon & Schuster
data_source: Proxy reconstruction: Eurostat HETUS time-use (tus_00age, AC82 TV & video) + OWID generalized trust (WVS/integrated surveys). Not a direct Putnam replication.

name: Mitscherlich Yield Curve
original_paper: Mitscherlich EA (1909) Landwirtschaftliche Jahrbücher 38:537-552
data_source: Engelstad & Parks (1971) Agronomy Journal 63:21-23, corn N-response (2 Tennessee locations x 5 years x 6 N rates; agridat::engelstad.nitro via Rdatasets); RECONSTRUCTION of the diminishing-returns form, NOT Mitscherlich's original 1909 data (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Green Revolution Yield Curve
original_paper: Borlaug NE (1960s) various; Evenson & Gollin (2003) Science
data_source: World Bank WDI: AG.YLD.CREL.KG (Global cereal yield)

name: Micronutrient U-shape (Vitamin D)
original_paper: Durup et al. (2012) J Clin Endocrinol Metab 97:2644-2652
data_source: Durup et al. (2012) J Clin Endocrinol Metab 97:2644-2652 (CopD study), Fig. 1A central spline (HR all-cause mortality vs 25(OH)D, ref 50 nmol/L); digitized (see data/digitized_sources.md)

name: Body Weight Set-Point
original_paper: Keesey RE, Hirvonen MD (1997) Am J Clin Nutr 66:1026-1032
data_source: Leibel, Rosenbaum & Hirsch (1995) NEJM 332:621-628, Fig. 2 (observed-minus-predicted TEE vs body-weight change); digitized. NOTE: variable definition changed from the previous 'caloric change vs weight change' (see data/digitized_sources.md)
